fragments.text: I'd also like to get a log of timings for each click and its phases

reply_text:
Every phase already emits start/end events with `:duration-ms`. I'm finding out where the service writes them.The script works now. I'm committing it by its own path.The timings were already being recorded, so I didn't add any logging. `futon2/data/wm-full-loop-phases.edn.log` gets a start line and an end line for every phase, with `:duration-ms`. I wrote `futon2/scripts/wm_click_timings.py` (commit `592529e63`) to turn that log into a per-click table:

```
scripts/wm_click_timings.py              # last 10 clicks
scripts/wm_click_timings.py -n 30
scripts/wm_click_timings.py --since 2026-09-30
scripts/wm_click_timings.py --tsv        # one row per phase
```

Each click is listed with its start time and total span. Its phases follow in the order they ended, each with seconds and outcome. Phases that never ended are marked OPEN, so a click that is still running or died shows up.

Timings from this morning's clicks:

| click | span | selection | author-wait | reviewer-wait | outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 01:16 | died in construction | 128.7 s | – | – | error |
| 03:12 (#13) | 547 s | 41.4 s | 100.6 s | 124.3 s | grounded-change |
| 04:28 (#14) | 211 s | 38.6 s | 44.2 s | – | build-failed |
| 04:34 (#15) | running | 33.3 s | | | |

Before selection, every click spends about 45–60 s on readiness, code-state, preflight and stop-line checks. `preference-refresh` ranged from 5 s to 84 s. In the successful click, the two agent waits took about 4 of its 9 minutes.

One recording bug turned up while I was building this. `emit-phase!` builds each line as `(merge {:at now} context event)`, so an `:at` already in the context overrides the real time. For example, click #13's `opportunity` end line says 03:18:32, but that phase started at 03:12:11 and ran for 547 s. The script takes the span from the phase's own duration, so the table above is correct. The fix is to put `:at` last in the merge. I'll make that change, but not while click #15 is running in that code.
